messages.app.name: Open Banking Protocol
messages.app.tagline: Community-backed loans for people banks leave out.
messages.loan.cancel_reason.AUCTION_FAILED: Lenders did not offer the full amount at or below your maximum interest rate. Nobody lost money; you can try again.
messages.loan.cancel_reason.IDENTITY: Your identity check was no longer valid when the loan was about to be funded.
messages.loan.cancel_reason.SCORE: The risk score expired or was withdrawn before funding. Ask for a new score.
messages.loan.cancel_reason.COLLATERAL: Not enough collateral was posted. You needed at least {required}.
messages.loan.cancel_reason.COVER: Your vouchers did not stake enough. The loan needed {required} of voucher backing.
messages.loan.cancel_reason.ECONOMIC_SECURITY: In your region, collateral plus voucher backing must cover the whole loan.
messages.loan.cancel_reason.CREDIT_LIMIT: This loan is bigger than your current credit limit of {limit}. Repaying loans raises your limit.
messages.loan.cancel_reason.INSURANCE_CAPACITY: The insurance pool for loans like this was full. Try a smaller amount or add backing.
messages.loan.cancel_reason.DRAWDOWN_EXPIRED: The loan agreement was not signed in time, so the money went back to the lenders.
messages.error.sanctioned: This wallet cannot use the protocol because it is on a sanctions list.
messages.error.jurisdiction_blocked: Loans are not available in your country at the moment.
messages.error.exceeds_credit_limit: The amount is above your credit limit of {limit}.
messages.error.below_min_slice: The smallest amount you can vouch is {min}.
messages.error.bid_too_small: The smallest bid for this loan is {min}.
messages.concept.collateral: Money you lock yourself. You get it back when the loan is repaid.
messages.concept.voucher: A person who trusts you and locks their own money to back your loan. They earn a fee when you repay and lose part of their stake if you do not.
messages.concept.insurance_pool: A shared pool that pays lenders if a loan is not repaid, after your collateral and your vouchers.
messages.concept.reserve: A safety fund that pays if an insurance pool runs out. A small fee from each loan goes into it.
messages.concept.rate_auction: Lenders compete to offer you the lowest interest rate. Everyone who funds your loan gets the same rate.
messages.concept.credit_limit: The most you can borrow now. It starts small and grows every time you repay a loan.
messages.concept.installment: A regular payment. Your loan is paid back in equal installments.
messages.concept.default: When payments stop for too long. Your collateral is used first, then your vouchers' stakes.
messages.concept.currency_risk: Your loan is in dollars. If your local currency falls, each installment costs more in local money.
messages.repay.late_warning: Your payment is late. If it stays unpaid for {days} days, the loan defaults and your vouchers lose money.
messages.underwriter.summary: Risk level {band} of 5 (1 is the lowest risk). Estimated chance of not repaying: {pd}. Suggested voucher backing: {cover} of the loan.
messages.underwriter.disclaimer: This score is advice for lenders, not a decision. People decide whether to fund your loan.
messages.loan.purpose.1: Stock for a shop or small business
messages.loan.purpose.8: Motorbike, rickshaw or vehicle for work
